userStories.title: Add retry_budget fallback initialization when config missing
acceptanceCriteria: When caption_config.retry_budget is None or missing, create a default CaptionRetryBudget with auto_scale=True
Log INFO message when using fallback: 'Using default retry budget (config missing)'
The fallback budget MUST have auto_scale=True to prevent budget exhaustion on large batches
Add unit test verifying fallback is created when rb_config is None
Add unit test verifying fallback has auto_scale=True by default
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (quick fix). Target: src/stages/caption_stage.py:226-237. Root cause of budget exhaustion: when retry_budget config section is absent, retry_budget stays None and no budget protection exists. This caused 100/100 exhaustion on 175 video batch.

userStories.title: Log budget scaling decision for debugging
acceptanceCriteria: Log INFO when auto_scale is enabled: 'Retry budget auto_scale enabled, batch_size={N}'
Log INFO after scaling: 'Retry budget scaled: {old} -> {new} for {batch_size} videos'
Log WARNING when auto_scale is disabled: 'Retry budget auto_scale DISABLED, max_attempts={N} may be insufficient for batch of {batch_size}'
Add unit test verifying INFO log when scaling occurs
Add unit test verifying WARNING log when auto_scale is False with large batch
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (diagnostic). Target: src/stages/caption_stage.py:585-602. Added budget scaling decision logging with INFO for auto_scale enabled and WARNING for disabled with large batch. Tests in TestBudgetScalingLogging class.

Tests in TestBatchProcessorBudgetStatus (test_batch_processor.py) and TestBudgetStatusDisplay (test_stage_caption.py).
